mahjongcraft_example.action.declare.card:
Show other players your Declared marker.
No score change; your hand stays hidden.
mahjongcraft_example.action.declare.desc: After drawing, press Declare to show other players your Declared marker. You can do this once per round. It does not change your score or reveal your hand.
mahjongcraft_example.ai.tsumogiri.name: Tsumogiri
mahjongcraft_example.catalogue.entry.pai: A 2–4 player game. Everyone starts with 100 points and three tiles. Draw one and discard one until four tiles form two pairs to win by self-draw; calls and ron are unavailable. The room settings choose each player's payment and the number of rounds. Before a round, each player may give two chosen tiles to the next seat and receive two from the previous seat. Once per round after drawing, you can declare to show other players a Declared marker. This does not change your score or reveal your hand.
mahjongcraft_example.room.config.field.e: Before the round, each player gives two chosen tiles to the next seat and receives two tiles from the previous seat.
mahjongcraft_example.room.config.field.r: Number of rounds in the match.
